findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 1 display line(s) start inside the margin but run off the right edge by a few pixels: "LeanLoop" (1px)
findings.fix: Fit the line to the content box by measurement (a small fit script, or SVG text with textLength), or bleed it on purpose by a clear amount from the margin. A name sliced by a few pixels on one side reads as a mistake.
